purpose: machine-readable + human-readable matrix mapping proposed paper claims (families A-L) to exact frozen evidence

global_constraints.no_superiority_language: No claim may use superiority/optimal/SOTA wording; evidence is preservation/non-inferiority/ablative/descriptive only.
global_constraints.no_confirmatory_claims: Phase31: no confirmatory significance procedure eligible; only descriptive CIs exist.
global_constraints.no_external_validation_claims: Phase32: no eligible external cohort; external validation not performed.
global_constraints.test_confirmed_false_all: No claim is TEST-confirmed (TEST locked until Phase39).
global_constraints.phase30_deviation_prominent: Any Phase30-based claim must carry the protocol-deviation qualifier prominently.

claims.claim_statement: The frozen A8/C9 policy preserves macro-domain Dice relative to the canonical GlobalMedFiLM global reference on the development population.
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: PRESERVATION / NON-INFERIORITY ONLY. Permitted: 'preserved', 'non-inferior within the prespecified margin'. FORBIDDEN: 'improved', 'superior', 'enhanced', 'outperforms'.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: Phase27 is CONTINUITY_DEVELOPMENT_EVIDENCE (development population). Phase30 is a ONE-SHOT ROUTER_HOLDOUT result that MUST carry the disclosed protocol-deviation qualifier: ONE_SHOT_ROUTER_HOLDOUT_RESULT_WITH_DISCLOSED_POST_FIRST_OPEN_SCIENTIFIC_SOURCE_FREEZE_DEVIATION

claims.claim_statement: Within the 13-arm ablation on ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT, the learned router and post-safety stage contribute positively to routed benefit capture, while the F1 integrated refiner did NOT improve the canonical pipeline (negative result).
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: CONTRIBUTION / ABLATION. Permitted: 'contributes', 'increases benefit capture', 'did not improve (negative result)'. FORBIDDEN: 'optimal', 'best', 'state-of-the-art'.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: Ablation confined to ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT; ROUTER_HOLDOUT/TEST/VAL808 reads = 0; no deployment winner selected; canonical bundle unchanged; F1 refiner result is a reported NEGATIVE result.

claims.claim_statement: The canonical policy reproduces across three seeds (42/123/3407) on both ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT and VAL808, with sign-consistent positive macro DeltaDice and no best-seed selection.
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: DESCRIPTIVE REPRODUCIBILITY ONLY. Permitted: 'reproduced across three seeds (descriptive)', 'sign-consistent'. FORBIDDEN: 'statistically confirmed', 'significant', 'passes a reproducibility gate'.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: NO_NUMERIC_REPRODUCIBILITY_PASS_FAIL_GATE; descriptive only; no seed ranking; no best-seed selection; global Dice is seed-invariant (range=0).

claims.claim_statement: The one-shot ROUTER_HOLDOUT evaluation (n=875) is the final development validation: macro DeltaDice +0.001739 with 95% CI [0.001117, 0.002405], satisfying the prespecified non-inferiority margin.
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: ONE-SHOT NON-INFERIORITY WITH DISCLOSED PROTOCOL DEVIATION. Permitted: the exact allowed wording. FORBIDDEN: 'confirmatory', 'validated on an independent holdout without caveat', 'no protocol deviations'.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: MANDATORY PROMINENT QUALIFIER: ONE_SHOT_ROUTER_HOLDOUT_RESULT_WITH_DISCLOSED_POST_FIRST_OPEN_SCIENTIFIC_SOURCE_FREEZE_DEVIATION. Allowed wording: On the one-shot ROUTER_HOLDOUT evaluation, the frozen A8/C9 policy produced a macro-domain Dice difference of +0.001739 with 95% CI [0.001117, 0.002405], satisfying the prespecified numerical non-inferiority margin. A protocol deviation occurred because the Stage-B scientific scoring source was not included in the pre-open source freeze; predictions and decision rules were frozen before GT access, GT was read once, and no scientific rerun or recomputation occurred.

claims.claim_statement: No new confirmatory significance procedure is eligible; the statistical evidence consists solely of descriptive bootstrap CIs from Phases 27 and 30. Zero new p-values, effect sizes, or bootstrap computations were authorized.
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: GOVERNANCE ONLY. Permitted: 'no confirmatory significance procedure eligible', 'descriptive CIs only'. FORBIDDEN: any confirmatory significance, p-value, or hypothesis-test claim.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: NO_NEW_CONFIRMATORY_SIGNIFICANCE_PROCEDURE_IS_ELIGIBLE; Phase30 outcomes were known before any Phase31 specification; no new confirmatory procedure may be created merely because it is conventional.

claims.claim_statement: No prospective clean external cohort is eligible for external validation; of 19 discovered external candidates, 0 are primary- or secondary-eligible, 8 are historically outcome-exposed, and 11 are ineligible.
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: NEGATIVE RESULT. Permitted: 'no eligible external cohort available', 'external validation not performed'. FORBIDDEN: 'generalizes to external domains', 'external validation confirms', 'unseen external test set'.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: NO_PROSPECTIVE_CLEAN_EXTERNAL_COHORT_ELIGIBLE; no cohort may be called an untouched external validation set; discovery was metadata/directory-listing only (0 pixels read).

claims.claim_statement: Descriptive final-system failure analysis on the frozen ROUTER_HOLDOUT tables: LOW_OVERLAP affects 10.1% of 875 rows; harmful router activation affects 12.9% of the 240 EXECUTE rows; missed-benefit and empty-prediction are 0; execute-then-reject affects 1.7% of EXECUTE rows.
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: DESCRIPTIVE FAILURE CHARACTERIZATION. Permitted: descriptive prevalence of failure families. FORBIDDEN: 'rare failure', 'negligible', 'clinically safe'.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: ONE_SHOT_ROUTER_HOLDOUT_RESULT_WITH_DISCLOSED_POST_FIRST_OPEN_SCIENTIFIC_SOURCE_FREEZE_DEVIATION qualifier preserved; tier0/tier1 frozen-table evidence only; KUB carries the highest low-overlap (0.2450) and harmful-activation (0.0872) domain rates.

claims.claim_statement: Conditional computation: the A8/C9 expected analytical MAC lower bound is 3.244e10 (ratio 1.028 vs global-only; saving 2.345e9 MACs vs always-refine). Measured hardware-specific latency: SKIP 15.72 ms, EXECUTE 18.89 ms, weighted 16.59 ms (RTX 3060 Ti).
claims.evidence_population: analytical + measured synthetic batch path (RTX 3060 Ti)
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: HARDWARE-SPECIFIC DESCRIPTIVE EFFICIENCY. Permitted: 'analytical MAC lower bound', 'measured latency on RTX 3060 Ti'. FORBIDDEN: 'end-to-end pipeline latency', 'real-time', 'mobile', 'energy-efficient', 'hardware-independent'.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: WEIGHTED_HARDWARE_SPECIFIC_RUNTIME_ESTIMATE; NOT_DIRECT_HOLDOUT_RUNTIME; NOT_END_TO_END_PIPELINE_LATENCY; hardware=NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti; v1.3 latency superseded by v1.4 (measurement granularity defect repaired); no end-to-end/energy/mobile/real-time/hardware-independent claim is made.

claims.claim_statement: Descriptive model-mechanism evidence: FiLM gamma/beta parameters are task-modulated (largest at decoder1/bridge), router attribution concentrates on decoder1 global/ROI feature groups, and saliency self-consistency is quantified per layer/domain.
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: DESCRIPTIVE MODEL MECHANISM. Permitted: 'task-modulated', 'attribution concentrates on', 'self-consistency quantified'. FORBIDDEN: 'causes', 'proves', 'explains why', any causal wording.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: DESCRIPTIVE_MODEL_MECHANISM_EVIDENCE; causal_experiment_authorized_by_phase35=false; evidence families never merged; forbidden causal wording applies; interpretability is not a causal claim.

claims.claim_statement: Synthetic image-perturbation robustness on VAL808: 12,928 paired rows across 16 conditions (brightness/contrast/gamma/blur/noise/resolution) x 4 domains; clean G reproduction is bit-identical and clean equivalence all_pass.
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: DEVELOPMENT-SET SYNTHETIC PERTURBATION ROBUSTNESS. Permitted: 'robust to synthetic image perturbations on the development set'. FORBIDDEN: 'robust to real-world acquisition shift', 'robust to scanner variation', 'clinically robust'.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: DEVELOPMENT_SET_SYNTHETIC_PERTURBATION_ROBUSTNESS_EVIDENCE; synthetic perturbations only (not real acquisition shift); test_reads=0; router_holdout_reads=0; worst-case is a per-sample min over realized perturbations, not a tail-risk guarantee.

claims.claim_statement: Synthetic proposal-perturbation robustness on VAL808: 4,848 paired rows across 6 proposal conditions; proposal perturbations produce near-zero paired DeltaDice with high prediction-consistency.
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: DEVELOPMENT-SET SYNTHETIC PROPOSAL PERTURBATION ROBUSTNESS. Permitted: 'robust to synthetic proposal perturbations'. FORBIDDEN: 'robust to proposal-algorithm variation', 'proposal-independent'.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: DEVELOPMENT_SET_SYNTHETIC_PERTURBATION_ROBUSTNESS_EVIDENCE; synthetic proposal perturbations only; not a re-run of proposal generation; not real proposal-algorithm variation.

claims.claim_statement: KUB subgroup observations (Kidney_Stone / Bladder_Stone / Ureteric_Stone) are REPORTING-ONLY metadata: subgroup robustness is reported by condition but KUB subgroups are never segmentation classes, task IDs, model inputs, or routing/conditioning variables.
claims.allowed_strength_of_wording: REPORTING-ONLY. Permitted: 'reported as metadata only'. FORBIDDEN: any use as segmentation class, task ID, model input, routing input, or conditioning variable.
claims.required_limitation_qualifier: KUB subgroups are REPORTING-ONLY metadata sourced from manifests/phase4_v3/val.csv::category; they must never become segmentation classes, task IDs, model inputs, routing inputs, or conditioning variables.
